excerpts.reason: Re-trimmed excerpt verified: both segments are verbatim in JFB/40/12/31 ('all sin--whether in its ordinary or its more aggravated forms--shall find forgiveness with God' and 'There is no sin whatever, it seems, of which it may be said'). The single ellipsis join drops only the intervening Mark 3:28 cross-reference and preserves JFB's sense (universal pardon is the governing principle). The trailing trim ('of which it may be said.') ends just before JFB's quoted clause 'That is not a pardonable sin' but does not distort. Directly on THIS tension: JFB makes v.31a's universal forgiveness the governing principle and subordinates the v.32 exception to it ('This glorious assurance is not to be limited by what follows; but, on the contrary, what follows is to be explained by this'), harmonizing the unforgivable-sin saying with the universal-pardon texts. Reconcile pole correct.

guardrails.reason: NAMED_SKEPTIC = STRAWMAN: Bart Ehrman and Jesus, Interrupted (HarperOne, 2009) are real, and Ehrman does discuss the blasphemy-against-the-Spirit / unforgivable-sin saying. BUT his treatment addresses the tension INTERNAL to the Synoptic saying ('all sins forgiven... but blasphemy of the Spirit will not be') and what it means — he is NOT documented framing it as a contradiction with the Acts/Pauline universal-pardon texts (Acts 10:43, 13:39; Col 2:13; 1 John 1:9). The row's connective specifically claims Ehrman 'notes that the unqualified all sins forgiven promises in Acts and the Pauline epistles sit in unresolved tension with Jesus's explicit exception' — that is a specific cross-corpus objection attributed to Ehrman that the verified sources (Ehrman's own discussion of the saying) do not support. Misrepresentation of the skeptic's actual objection = strawman. CONNECTIVES = FLAG (consequence of the above): the connective overclaims the scope of what Ehrman argues. DISCREPANCY_INTEGRITY = CO_OPTED: a genuinely_disputed/discrepancy_first row whose named skeptic is misattributed to this specific cross-corpus framing and which carries no justified relabel_flag; the discrepancy pole needs a skeptic who actually presses the Synoptic-vs-Acts/epistles tension, or a relabel. DEEPER_LEARNING = OK: Haley (1874) is a real PD harmonization work and demonstrably treats the unpardonable-sin / blasphemy-against-the-Spirit discrepancy (a classic Haley entry); the note's description (settled willful rejection of the Spirit vs. ordinary sin) matches Haley's known argument. PARITY structurally ok but the skeptic side is compromised by the strawman.
